feature_contract.goal: Keep the original OutRun C993 central lens flare's original-game c64 world projection finite, same-source and same-draw throughout native R84 eye reprojection without doubling its centre or disturbing independent outer rings and SkyGlow.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact original D3A5→C980→C993 central lens WorldBillboard c64..c67 shader source only; unrelated register uploads, CABE outer lens rings, SkyGlow, original D3D9 draw, FFB/input, R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK must remain unchanged.
trace_stages: Original EXE centre producer D3A5→C980→C993 scoped game DrawObjectAlphaCentre starts original-world projection.

Original D3D9 shader SetVertexShaderConstantF writes full or split c64..c67 rows with device, shader binding, producer, pose, present and draw identity; PartialWvpUpload rejects any NaN/Inf c64 candidate atomically while never rejecting neighboring constants.

R84 native original draw remains conservatively available when source admission fails; strictly finite and source-owned original matrix is the only candidate for world-to-left/right-eye lens re-projection and subsequent host OpenXR composition.
subcomponents: Protect complete and split source c64..c67 uploads against NaN/Inf before accepting or committing original lens matrix for the native stereo re-projection path.
Invalidate stale partial/committed source rows on malformed producer upload while passing through unrelated original game constants and the original draw without altering outer lens rings.
Retain constexpr/compiled positive complete and split source cases and negative NaN/Inf/stale/foreign source cases in the lens_centre_partial_wvp.hpp regression contract.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original exact central flare may be eye reprojected only from source-owned finite complete c64 world projection, including same-draw split rows.
Invalid central lens source aborts stereo ownership atomically, does not poison later split uploads, and never rejects original game draw or neighboring non-c64 rows and outer effects.
All required final exact-SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact actions pass before build verified status; Quest3 HMD visual acceptance stays separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: C993 lens centre original-world c64..c67 may be set over full or partial original-game D3D9 shader constant writes; R84 captures those rows before applying stereo matrices.
diagnosis.root_cause: Existing native lens partial-source WVP constructor accepted non-finite original-game c64 values that Direct3D9 upload may carry, allowing NaN/Inf to contaminate per-eye world projection and reuse of partially committed prior source matrices.
source_trace: Original EXE D3A5→C980→C993 central lens producer is independent of the original CABE outer disc chain.
R84 source provenance stages c64..c67 constant rows for same producer/shader/device/pose and native Draw; invalid rows now reset the entire candidate.
Finite same-draw original-game WVP is admitted to guarded R84 per-eye processing; invalid source must fall back to one original-game draw and keep input and SkyGlow intact.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only validated original-game finite centre WVP is a candidate for left and right eye stereo reprojection; this source guard does not establish physical HMD optical success.
alternatives_rejected: Do not reclassify CABE outer flare disks as centre or blanket-disable alpha, world particles or SkyGlow.
Do not substitute stale live shader constants for unknown original C993 writes or widen draw-age without producer proof.
Do not suppress the original native D3D9 draw when stereo provenance fails.
